title: WorldStream
tagline: Streaming application inside the worldcoin app with verified humans
description: We built the first livestreaming service on Worldcoin. Because of the human verification we can gurantee that only real humans can comment in your stream, because of this we prevent bots that are used for targeted shitstorms and bots for more engagement so that you rank higher compared to other streamers
how_its_made: This project is built as a Worldcoin Mini App. For the Video streaming we use the WebRTC Server from AntMedia. All the payment and verification logic is used from the WorldcoinMinikit Sdk. We encountered a lot of bug with the worldcoin mini app where the livestreaming doesent work for one person but for the other it works eventhough they are using the same mini app hosted on the same server
